name: GraphQL contract changes update generated artifacts
instruction: Backend GraphQL contract and frontend GraphQL document changes are accompanied by the generated schema and typed client artifacts they affect.
relevant_when: Diff that changes backend GraphQL resolvers, DTOs, models, gql-codegen configuration, GraphQL operation documents, or generated GraphQL schema/type artifacts.
context: The repo generates gql-gen/backend-schema.gql in the backend and packages/hoppscotch-common/src/helpers/backend/graphql.ts plus backend-schema.json from gql-codegen.yml; recent PR feedback called out missing frontend error union types when backend errors changed.
scope_reason: The invariant is about companion files being changed together in one patch.

checklist.name: backend-contract-regenerates-schema
checklist.rule: If backend GraphQL schema, resolver return types, DTOs, models, enums, or API error unions change in a way that affects the GraphQL contract, the diff includes the regenerated gql-gen/backend-schema.gql artifact.

checklist.name: frontend-documents-regenerate-types
checklist.rule: If GraphQL operation documents or the backend GraphQL schema used by the frontend change, the diff includes regenerated frontend GraphQL artifacts such as packages/hoppscotch-common/src/helpers/backend/graphql.ts or backend-schema.json.
